# CODEX

> > Professional digital cinema workflow solutions featuring HDE (High Density Encoding) media capture, Vault systems, and ARRIRAW recording for ARRI ALEXA cameras.

CODEX provides industry-leading recording and post-production workflow tools for high-end cinematography, serving productions from Hollywood features to space-based IMAX filming. The company specializes in HDE encoding technology, Vault media stations, and seamless integration with ARRI camera systems.

## Key Topics

- HDE (High Density Encoding)
- ARRIRAW recording
- Vault media stations
- ARRI ALEXA cameras (Mini LF, 65, XT)
- Action Cam
- ProRes transcoding
- Production Suite software
- Post-production workflows
- Cinematography workflows
- DNxHD/MXF formats
- VFS (Virtual File System)
- Capture Drive management
- Editorial dailies creation
- American Society of Cinematographers (ASC)
- Film production case studies

- [CODEX](https://codex.online/default): CODEX homepage: HDE media capture, readers & production workflow tools
